defects.problem: Seven-plus seconds of a static code card changing only highlight position; a viewer sees the same five lines of small code for the whole section with no visual progress
defects.fix: Hold the same layout but add reveal by line (dim unselected lines further) so the card has a visible rhythm

defects.problem: The code card has an empty bottom band and the right-column text is a second, redundant list repeating the code card's meaning
defects.fix: Reduce the redundancy: drop the right column or the label under the card

defects.problem: Source path labels are small grey and low contrast
defects.fix: Raise the label size and contrast

defects.problem: Final frames hold the same state for many samples, dead time
defects.fix: Shorten the final hold or tighten the cut to the next section

couldNotAssess: Whether the highlight animations feel smooth
oneLineVerdict: Clean, stable, honest evidence of code, but visually plain and static for its length.
